description: Polyphonic ADSR envelope. The number of voices follows the channels arriving at the gate input, two insert VCAs multiply a signal by the envelope, and each stage has its own pulse output

params.text: The rise time, 0 at the anticlockwise end; the menu sets whether the clockwise end is 1 second, 10 seconds or 100 seconds
The fall time down to the sustain level; the menu sets whether the clockwise end is 1 second, 10 seconds or 100 seconds
The level the envelope holds at while the gate is high, 0 to the full height of the envelope
The fall time once the gate drops; the menu sets whether the clockwise end is 1 second, 10 seconds or 100 seconds
Bends the shape of the stages, straight at the anticlockwise end and strongly exponential at the clockwise end
Scales the envelope from -2 to +2, so negative settings turn it upside down
How much of the voltage at the attack CV input reaches the rise time
How much of the voltage at the decay CV input reaches the decay time
How much of the voltage at the sustain CV input reaches the sustain level
How much of the voltage at the release CV input reaches the release time
How much of the voltage at the LIN-EXP CV input reaches the shape of the stages
How much of the voltage at the SCALE CV input reaches the scaling of the envelope
Makes every new gate start the envelope from 0V rather than from the level it has reached
Makes a new gate count only while the envelope is idle, so a gate during the envelope is ignored
How much of the envelope is applied to that insert, -2 to +2, default 1

inputs.text: A voltage moving the rise time
A voltage moving the decay time
A voltage moving the sustain level
A voltage moving the release time
A voltage moving the shape of the stages
A voltage moving the scaling of the envelope
The gate that runs the envelope; a polyphonic cable here sets how many voices the module runs
A signal to be multiplied by the envelope
A voltage added to the envelope output

outputs.text: The envelope itself, with the voltage at the chain input added to it
Passes the gate straight through, so several of these can be run from one gate
The signal at that insert's input multiplied by the envelope
Fires when the rise ends, at the top of the envelope
Fires when the fall to the sustain level ends
Fires when the sustain ends, as the gate drops
Fires when the envelope finishes its release and reaches 0V
The envelope with its sign turned round, so it runs downwards from 0V

menu: Time Ranges — a submenu of Time Range: 1 second, Time Range: 10 second and Time Range: 100 second, setting the full span of the attack, decay and release knobs
